lines.speaker: perimeter_scav
lines.text: Service line. Parts on the ground the whole length of it, nobody allocated to pick them up, and a patrol that has flown the same circuit for eighty years without once changing the turn.

lines.speaker: perimeter_scav
lines.text: I am not stealing. You cannot steal a thing that is not on any list — there is no owner, there is no entry, there is nobody to have taken it from. I have had a great deal of time out here to think about that and it still holds.

lines.speaker: perimeter_scav
lines.text: There is a plaque at the service gate with four hundred and six names on it. I read it every shift, start to finish. I have no idea who any of them are and I read it anyway.

lines.speaker: perimeter_scav
lines.text: Somebody put the cooling fields on a public register. Half the parts out here have a name attached to them now, and an owner, and I have not decided how I feel about that.
